plan.title: Convert RFQ to Auction Without Carried Bids

steps.note: Open an existing concluded event with RFQ quotations.

args.goal: On the conversion prompt, uncheck the option to carry RFQ quotations into the auction, configure the converted auction, click Save, and stop on the auction create screen ready to publish

steps.note: Perform the conversion configuration and explicitly leave the carry-forward bids checkbox unchecked.
